verdict.rationale: Official docs only describe Lovable being turned INTO an MCP server for other AI assistants (docs-8/26), which is the reverse direction of the story. A single community comment from a self-described former Lovable agent-team member claims the underlying agent harness itself uses MCPs, skills, and subagents internally, suggesting some capacity to consume MCP tools, but there's no first-party documentation of users plugging in their own MCP servers or configuring which tools Lovable's agent can call. Missing for 10: official documentation of user-configurable MCP client integration, a list of supported MCP servers, and independent confirmation that end-users (not just the internal build agent) can attach arbitrary MCP servers.
